name: CoNC-ExactTopo-v1.1-strict-RQ1-4
split: Reuse audited 20261019 connected-component split; source case, family, normalized/exact text and full consumed-input identities isolated
backbone: Reuse verified full CoNC stage1/stage2 checkpoints trained from scratch only on this strict TRAIN with strict DEV selection; never load historical-family heads or backbones
architecture: Unchanged v1.1 ExactFusion, 105089 trainable parameters; frozen strict CoNC; exact signed32 COPY/ADD/SUB
cache: Fresh strict-checkpoint FP32 logits and approximate FP16 pooled context, exact integer channel stored separately

evaluation.unit: paired connected component, average seeds within each draw
evaluation.primary: full strict TEST F1 plus precision recall specificity MCC AUROC AP and coverage
evaluation.rq3: reuse fixed target-syntax definitions, report absent or single-class strata
evaluation.rq4: same-ID static complementarity; disclose static coverage and report same-static-evidence control

test_gate: Freeze all nine DEV-selected adapter checkpoints before new TEST scoring; no recipe search on this split
limitations: Retrospective data already used in previous experiments, not a pristine holdout
Lexical and consumed-input disjointness is not semantic-clone certification
Connected components induce class-prior shift and a large indivisible TRAIN component
Exact arithmetic is conditional on supplied graph, not full C semantics
